get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying properties, associations, and whether to include archived records. This endpoint is useful for retrieving a list of CRM objects with specific details and associations.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

after.description: A string token that indicates the position after the last successfully read resource, used for fetching the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and each value is the property's new value. All properties must be strings.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between a specified object and another object type, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between different CRM objects.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token that indicates the position after the last successfully read resource, used for fetching the next page of results.

link.description: A URL string that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object includes details about the associated object and the types of associations.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each including a label. This defines the types of associations and their labels between the objects.

category.description: The category of the association, which can be one of 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', or 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object from which the association originates.

label.description: A string label that describes the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object to which the association is directed.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object that is being associated. It is a string value.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
